scope: Native Rust filtered lifecycle backend only; public lifecycle integration belongs to the root agent.

behavior.vectors: Sealed NativeVector supports u8 and f32 with Pod + owned serde bounds, stable encoding, finite f32 validation, and native SIMD squared-L2 kernels.
behavior.artifacts: Consumes caller-written vectors.bin, writes a canonical 24-byte no-frozen-point memgraph header and adjacency rows, trains fresh fixed-256-centroid Rust PQ, compresses source vectors, invokes DiskIndexWriter for 4096-byte graph blocks, and removes the temporary memgraph.
behavior.reader: Linux uses existing io_uring O_DIRECT aligned factory; Windows uses existing native aligned factory; macOS uses FileExt::read_exact_at with F_NOCACHE and A512 requests. Miri uses existing fallback.
behavior.isolated_nodes: Removed only the positive-degree debug assertion from DiskIndexWriter; singleton-label and unlabeled rows may have empty adjacency in multi-row graphs.

validation.kind: cross-target type check only; no Linux runtime or linker execution

temporary_integration_state: At validation time filtered/mod.rs declares mod native; the root lifecycle integration is in progress. Dead-code warnings occur until integration consumes the backend. No permanent allow attributes were added. Full integration clippy remains to be run by the root agent once all modules are connected.
platform_execution: Tests executed locally on aarch64 macOS with Rust 1.97.1; Linux branch was cross-checked, not run.
benchmark_claim: No native lifecycle performance or recall claim follows from these roundtrip tests.
